node.title: Re^5: Shrink Images and PDFs
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You can see problems just by looking at the test matrix

IIRC (it's been a long time), installing it from CPAN never really worked well (or at all?); I remember the Perl module would get built when one complied ImageMagick from source. But even then, finnicky business I think. In any case, [mod://Imager] is a nice alternative ([https://youtu.be/gW0rkx4CTAg|"Nicholas Clark - How Geizhals took out ImageMagick before ImageMagick took *us* out"]), and I haven't tried [http://www.graphicsmagick.org/|GraphicsMagick].
